scope: Four requested modern model families, six backend rows each, exact storage recipes and explicit product profiles. This table records evidence; it does not grant support to arbitrary GGUF formats or architectures.

backend_notes.CUDA: Whole-model and dynamic stdio correctness in declared profiles. Only one Dense resident timing workload and earlier Dense local stdio SLO workload are qualified.
backend_notes.CPU_AVX2: Quant kernel implementation/dispatch is distinct from whole-model qualification; modern profiles need independent end-to-end coverage.
backend_notes.CPU_AVX512: Format-local quant kernels remain in src/quant; AVX512 operator checks do not prove these complete model profiles.
backend_notes.CPU_NEON128: NEON kernels exist in generic quant paths; no new modern whole-model ARM evidence is claimed.
backend_notes.CPU_scalar: Retained generic fallback/compatibility; no new modern model whole-runtime claim.
backend_notes.Metal: Existing optional backend/legacy support retained. These modern CUDA product profiles do not admit Metal. Modern whole-model qualification remains pending.

ownership.backend_layouts_and_resources: BnBackendModel/backend sessions; preparation validates supported weight roles/formats
ownership.requests: BnSession and shared BnGenerateBatch admission/control; retained idle payload counts

rejection_guards.options: src/main_gguf_batch_options.h and src/main_native_options.h strictly validate supported profile names/options.
rejection_guards.topology: src/main_gguf_batch.h checks architecture-owned BF16 layout before preparing backend state.
rejection_guards.quant: Backend model preparation consumes quant-registry role capabilities and rejects unsupported weights.

limitations: These entries are checkpoint/profile/workload claims, not universal model-family support.
Managed HOST/DEVICE payload limits are not physical process/device memory caps; opaque setup/driver/library allocations need separate peak evidence.
Native fused prefill has qualified joint GPU execution; folded/small/mixed-decode execution and full resident/offload performance qualification remain open.
CPU and Metal rows are unqualified; operator tests, compile support and generic architecture parsing do not establish end-to-end support.
Legacy models and WebGPU/WASM paths are retained through their existing shared paths; no removal is authorized by this table.
next_delivery: Qualify current native plus Flash Next/GLM sustained serving with explicit startup/working-set accounting; extend longer/unseen native histories and remaining resident parity/CPU/Metal coverage.
Qualify diverse cold/warm offloaded working sets, misses/transferred bytes/exposed stalls and setup/physical memory peaks.
Broaden matched resident prefill/decode and sustained-serving workloads.
Extend independent whole-model CPU AVX2/AVX512/NEON then Metal coverage.
